words.prose: {{ar:رَفِيعُ}} ({{tr:rafīʿu}}) opens as a predicate-like title before any finite action. The word makes divine elevation an asserted frame, and with {{ar:ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ}} ({{tr:d-darajāti}}) it specifies that height as ranked degrees rather than vague altitude. Its durable adjective form lets the later {{ar:يُلْقِى}} ({{tr:yulqī}}) descend from established height, while the accusative reading only shifts the title toward praise construction without undoing the authority frame.

topics.headline: fronted predicate title before action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears identity and rank before the action of sending begins.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a nominative qualitative adjective governing the following genitive, and the clause evidence places the nominal title stack before the main verb.

topics.headline: ranked elevation prepares descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Spirit's descent as movement from already exalted, ordered authority, not as a human ascent.
topics.reason: The root range supports raising and elevation, while the local construct with {{ar:ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ}} ({{tr:d-darajāti}}) narrows the height to ranked authority and the later {{ar:يُلْقِى}} ({{tr:yulqī}}) supplies the descent contrast.

topics.headline: case variant tests title handling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant case affects the title's syntax, while the title still frames the sending action.
topics.reason: The local QAC parse is nominative, so the accusative evidence is kept as a title-handling contrast rather than the governing parse for {{ar:رَفِيعُ}} ({{tr:rafīʿu}}).

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ}} ({{tr:d-darajāti}}) completes the first title as a genitive plural, so {{ar:رَفِيعُ}} ({{tr:rafīʿu}}) is not free-floating height. The plural degree-word turns exaltation into ordered tiers, and its position before {{ar:ذُو}} ({{tr:dhū}}) {{ar:ٱلْعَرْشِ}} ({{tr:l-ʿarshi}}) lets the opening move from graded rank to sovereign rule. The word also carries known degree-language from passages such as 58:11 and 6:83, but here the rank-holder is the one who will select and send.

topics.headline: genitive degrees define the height
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the opening height is measured in degrees, not left as an abstract claim.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces {{ar:ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ}} ({{tr:d-darajāti}}) as the genitive complement of {{ar:رَفِيعُ}} ({{tr:rafīʿu}}), closing the first title before the next construct begins.

topics.headline: plural degrees make rank scalar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a tiered hierarchy beneath the divine sending rather than undifferentiated greatness.
topics.reason: The root and plural form support stepwise ranked ascent, and the local plural makes that scalar field part of the title.

topics.headline: degrees precede the throne title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the opening climb from degrees to the Throne before the revelation verb appears.
topics.reason: Word order places {{ar:ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ}} ({{tr:d-darajāti}}) before {{ar:ذُو}} ({{tr:dhū}}) {{ar:ٱلْعَرْشِ}} ({{tr:l-ʿarshi}}), so the title stack moves from graded rank to the governing seat.

words.prose: {{ar:ذُو}} ({{tr:dhū}}) begins the second nominal title and requires {{ar:ٱلْعَرْشِ}} ({{tr:l-ʿarshi}}) as its genitive complement. Its possession morphology makes the Throne a held sovereign domain, not a spatial pose, and it continues a possessive frame later heard in {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}) and {{ar:عِبَادِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ʿibādihī}}). The formula also recalls throne-possession language such as 85:15 while keeping the local point on the authority behind the Spirit's casting.

topics.headline: construct possession forms a second title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a second predicate of possession complete the authority frame before the action starts.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse {{ar:ذُو}} ({{tr:dhū}}) as a nominative construct noun of possession governing {{ar:ٱلْعَرْشِ}} ({{tr:l-ʿarshi}}).

topics.headline: possession avoids spatial posture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reads the throne relation as sovereign ownership and authority rather than bodily location.
topics.reason: The possession term assigns God as possessor of {{ar:ٱلْعَرْشِ}} ({{tr:l-ʿarshi}}); this local morphology blocks reducing the title to posture.

topics.headline: throne possession opens a possessive chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Throne, command, and servants are all routed through divine possession.
topics.reason: The recurring throne-possession formula appears in evidence such as 85:15, and the local suffix chain later repeats possession in {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}) and {{ar:عِبَادِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ʿibādihī}}).

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَرْشِ}} ({{tr:l-ʿarshi}}) is definite and genitive, closing {{ar:ذُو}} ({{tr:dhū}}) as the known Throne title. Its root field supplies raised architecture for sovereignty, so the opening does not name empty height but an ordered governing summit. Against the resisting coverers at 40:14, the title answers opposition with elevated rule before the Spirit is sent from command; same-surah and wider references, including 40:7 and 7:54, sharpen that authorization.

topics.headline: known genitive throne completes the title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the title close on the known Throne, not on an indefinite throne-like object.
topics.reason: The definite genitive complement is syntactically forced after {{ar:ذُو}} ({{tr:dhū}}), making the construct title specific.

topics.headline: raised structure gives sovereignty shape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imagines sovereignty as elevated structure and rule, not as a bare seat image.
topics.reason: The root field includes raised support and throne imagery; the local title uses that architecture to express governing authority.

topics.headline: throne title grounds command-source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees resistance answered by elevated rule before the Spirit is sent from command.
topics.reason: The evidence links the throne field with command and with 40:7; locally {{ar:ٱلْعَرْشِ}} ({{tr:l-ʿarshi}}) precedes {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}), preparing command as sovereign directive.

words.prose: {{ar:يُلْقِى}} ({{tr:yulqī}}) is the first finite verb after the title stack, turning divine identity into action. Its Form IV valency gathers payload, source, and recipient: {{ar:ٱلرُّوحَ}} ({{tr:r-rūḥa}}), {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}), and {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}). The casting is purposeful delivery, not discarded throwing, and its root will return in {{ar:ٱلتَّلَاقِ}} ({{tr:t-talāq}}), so present sending anticipates final encounter.

topics.headline: verb organizes payload source and target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees revelation as a routed transfer with what is sent, where it comes from, and where it lands.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:ٱلرُّوحَ}} ({{tr:r-rūḥa}}) the object, {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}) the source phrase, and {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) the recipient phrase governed by {{ar:يُلْقِى}} ({{tr:yulqī}}).

topics.headline: main verb pivots from titles to mission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah move from who God is to what He sends.
topics.reason: The imperfect active resumes the divine subject from the nominal title stack and starts the main verbal predicate.

topics.headline: casting root returns as meeting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is delivered now is linked by root to what will be met later.
topics.reason: The same root family supports causing reception in {{ar:يُلْقِى}} ({{tr:yulqī}}) and reciprocal meeting in {{ar:ٱلتَّلَاقِ}} ({{tr:t-talāq}}), giving the ayah a present-delivery to final-encounter thread.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرُّوحَ}} ({{tr:r-rūḥa}}) is the definite accusative object of {{ar:يُلْقِى}} ({{tr:yulqī}}), so the payload is named before the source phrase explains it. Its breath, relief, and Spirit range makes the mission animating rather than merely informational, while the adjacent {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}) keeps that animation under divine command. The familiar Spirit-from-command formula, including 17:85, becomes operational here as a cast mission for warning.

topics.headline: definite Spirit is the cast payload
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Spirit as the immediate object of divine casting before source or recipient is named.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark {{ar:ٱلرُّوحَ}} ({{tr:r-rūḥa}}) as the definite accusative direct object of {{ar:يُلْقِى}} ({{tr:yulqī}}).

topics.headline: breath and Spirit range animates the mission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the payload as life-bearing and animating, while the local syntax keeps it tied to revelation and command.
topics.reason: The root evidence keeps breath, wind, relief, and Spirit imagery available, but the local object position after {{ar:يُلْقِى}} ({{tr:yulqī}}) and source phrase {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}) narrow it to revelation-linked agency.

topics.headline: Spirit is bound to command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that inspiration is not autonomous; it arrives from the command-domain.
topics.reason: The pairing of {{ar:ٱلرُّوحَ}} ({{tr:r-rūḥa}}) with {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}) matches evidence such as 17:85 and is locally specified by the warning mission.

words.prose: The first {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) stands between {{ar:ٱلرُّوحَ}} ({{tr:r-rūḥa}}) and {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}), making the Spirit's relation to command visible. It can be read as source, partitive, or explanatory classification, but all three readings keep the payload inside God's command-domain. Its later echo in the second {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) creates a paired frame: command-source first, servant-set second.

topics.headline: first min binds Spirit to command-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Spirit as from, within, or explained by command rather than detached inspiration.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}) after {{ar:ٱلرُّوحَ}} ({{tr:r-rūḥa}}); the grammatical options all preserve command-domain control.

topics.headline: first min prepares a second min
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a mirrored source-and-selection architecture in the two prepositional phrases.
topics.reason: The first {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) introduces {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}) as source/domain, while the second {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) later introduces {{ar:عِبَادِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ʿibādihī}}) as the servant set.

words.prose: {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}) is genitive after {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) and carries a fused suffix referring to God, so the source is His command. The word's range includes command, affair, decree, and executive directive; beside {{ar:ٱلرُّوحَ}} ({{tr:r-rūḥa}}), that range makes the Spirit both a divine matter and an authorized mission. It also precedes {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}), so source outranks recipient identity.

topics.headline: His command is the source-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the Spirit comes from God's own command before any servant acts.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}) as genitive after {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) with a 3ms divine suffix, and attachment evidence makes it the source or authority phrase.

topics.headline: command range gives executive authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the source as directive authority and divine affair, not a vague origin.
topics.reason: The root range supports command, affair, decree, commander, and one commanded; the local source phrase selects executive authority for the Spirit's mission.

topics.headline: command precedes servant selection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that authority is established before the human recipient is identified.
topics.reason: The local order puts {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}) before {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}), and the collocation evidence links command with Spirit and servants, including 17:85 and same-surah command scenes.

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) opens the recipient phrase and governs {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}). Its upon-sense marks a landing site, but the same preposition can also carry burden or commission, which fits the warning purpose that follows. Because it appears before the recipient is specified, placement and responsibility come into view before personal identity.

topics.headline: upon marks recipient landing and commission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Spirit placed upon someone as a commission, not merely located near someone.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence governs {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) by {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) as recipient complement of {{ar:يُلْقِى}} ({{tr:yulqī}}), while the preposition's range supports landing and burden.

topics.headline: placement precedes recipient identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah foregrounds the landing relation before naming who receives it.
topics.reason: The independent preposition {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) appears before {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}), so the recipient slot is opened by placement first.

words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) is the object of {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) and the relative pronoun completed by {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}). It keeps the recipient unnamed while still allowing a determinate selection: whoever God wills, from among His servants. The sequence moves from an open slot to divine will and then to bounded servanthood, shifting from the prior plural human command to a selected mission-bearer.

topics.headline: relative pronoun keeps recipient unnamed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a determinate recipient without premature naming.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) as governed by {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) and specified by {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}), holding recipient role and relative openness together.

topics.headline: open slot narrowed by will and servanthood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the recipient is selected through divine will and servant-status rather than social identity.
topics.reason: The local order runs {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}), then {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}), then {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) {{ar:عِبَادِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ʿibādihī}}), and the boundary row marks the shift from plural commanded callers to an unnamed chosen recipient.

words.prose: {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}) supplies the relative clause that specifies {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}). Its omitted subject is the same divine agent as {{ar:يُلْقِى}} ({{tr:yulqī}}), and its object is left unexpressed so the whole selection complex remains under divine will. The root's link between willing and thingness makes the open recipient become determinate, while its position before {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) {{ar:عِبَادِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ʿibādihī}}) shows that servanthood alone does not appoint the warner.

topics.headline: same divine agency wills and casts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees casting and selection as one divine agency chain.
topics.reason: The active imperfect has an omitted divine subject recoverable from the title stack and {{ar:يُلْقِى}} ({{tr:yulqī}}), with no explicit object limiting what the will covers.

topics.headline: will realizes an open possibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the open whoever becomes an actual servant by divine willing, not by prior naming.
topics.reason: The root evidence links willing with determination or thingness, and locally it follows the open relative pronoun.

topics.headline: will mediates before servant class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees servant-status bounded by will rather than automatically conferring mission.
topics.reason: The verb stands between {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) and {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) {{ar:عِبَادِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ʿibādihī}}); co-occurrence and 76:30 reinforce divine will over human selection.

words.prose: The second {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) is not the same function as the first. Here it governs {{ar:عِبَادِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ʿibādihī}}) and narrows the open recipient to a partitive subset among His servants. The repeated preposition creates a middle frame: the Spirit is from command, and the recipient is from servanthood.

topics.headline: second min narrows to servants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the recipient remain within servitude even after receiving the Spirit.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the second {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) as governing {{ar:عِبَادِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ʿibādihī}}) in a partitive subset relation, not as sourcing the Spirit.

topics.headline: two min phrases mirror source and selection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grammar balances upward command-source with downward servant-selection.
topics.reason: The first {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) introduces {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}), and the second {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) introduces {{ar:عِبَادِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ʿibādihī}}), creating paired source and membership phrases.

words.prose: {{ar:عِبَادِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ʿibādihī}}) closes the recipient-selection phrase as a genitive plural with a divine suffix. The chosen one is one from His servants, so mission remains grounded in dependence, worship, and service rather than independent status. The plural also keeps the recipient inside a servant community, and the same root resonates with later worship scenes in 40:60 and 40:66.

topics.headline: His servants bound by suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the selected recipient as belonging to God, not as an autonomous category of human authority.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) and bears the same divine suffix chain as {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihī}}), making the servant class possessed by God.

topics.headline: service and worship ground agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that warning authority is rooted in yielded service, not independent rank.
topics.reason: The root range includes worship, service, bondage, and dependence; locally the recipient of Spirit remains within that field.

topics.headline: plural servants frame selection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one mission-bearer selected from a wider servant community.
topics.reason: The plural form and final position after {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}) close the selection sequence; the same root appears in wider servitude scenes such as 25:63, 40:60, and 40:66.

words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) fuses to {{ar:يُنذِرَ}} ({{tr:yundhira}}) as a purpose lām and makes the following verb dependent. Its scope reaches back over the whole sending chain: casting, Spirit, command-source, recipient, will, and servants. The particle therefore turns selection into mission, with warning as the explicit goal rather than an optional result.

topics.headline: purpose lam governs the subjunctive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees warning as grammatically dependent on the prior casting, not as a new independent event.
topics.reason: QAC and clause evidence mark {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) as purpose lām attached to the subjunctive {{ar:يُنذِرَ}} ({{tr:yundhira}}).

topics.headline: purpose pivots selection to warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the entire middle grammar is routed toward eschatological warning.
topics.reason: The purpose clause follows the completed recipient phrase {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) {{ar:عِبَادِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ʿibādihī}}), so the whole route from source through recipient is made accountable to warning.

words.prose: {{ar:يُنذِرَ}} ({{tr:yundhira}}) is subjunctive after {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}), so warning is the purpose of Spirit-casting. The verb leaves the warned audience unspoken while {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) {{ar:ٱلتَّلَاقِ}} ({{tr:t-talāq}}) fills the horizon, drawing attention to the event before which notice is given. Form IV sends warning outward, and the person and voice variants make the agency hinge concrete: second-person warning highlights the addressee, passive warning lets the Day stand forward, and the local third-person form keeps the base chain in which God casts and the selected servant warns.

topics.headline: warning depends on the purpose clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees warning as the mission generated by casting, with agency routed through the sending chain.
topics.reason: The verb is subjunctive after {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}); referent evidence allows divine continuation or selected-servant agency under the casting chain.

topics.headline: audience omitted while the Day is foregrounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the warning points first to the Meeting event, not to an explicitly named audience.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) as the warning horizon and no explicit warned object, so the event focus carries the clause.

topics.headline: Form IV sends advance notice outward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears revelation as advance accountability before the encounter arrives.
topics.reason: The warning root and Form IV morphology support outward advance notice, and the local collocation with day and meeting fields confirms the event-oriented warning.

topics.headline: variants expose agency routing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that person and voice variants test how warning agency is routed through sender, addressee, and Day-focus.
topics.reason: The local bundle parses third-person active {{ar:يُنذِرَ}} ({{tr:yundhira}}), so second-person and passive readings are retained as contrastive evidence for the purpose-clause hinge rather than as the base parse.

words.gloss_range: accusative event-time, not neutral calendar duration, governing the Meeting title
words.root_gloss_range: accusative event-time, not neutral calendar duration, governing the Meeting title

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby term cited in this word prose for local syntax, sequence, or contrast

words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) is accusative event-time and construct head before {{ar:ٱلتَّلَاقِ}} ({{tr:t-talāq}}). It is not the warned audience; it is the horizon in relation to which warning is given. The word turns ordinary day-language into a decisive occasion named by encounter, and the nominative variant shows how the Day can be foregrounded without replacing the local accusative temporal parse.

topics.headline: accusative Day is warning horizon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Day as the temporal horizon warned about, not as the warned audience.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) as accusative temporal adverb, and attachment evidence relates it to {{ar:يُنذِرَ}} ({{tr:yundhira}}) as the warning time or event.

topics.headline: construct head named by Meeting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that time is defined by its event-content: the Meeting.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces {{ar:ٱلتَّلَاقِ}} ({{tr:t-talāq}}) as genitive complement of {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}), making the closing phrase one construct title.

topics.headline: day becomes decisive occasion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reads the Day as a bounded encounter-event, not a neutral calendar unit.
topics.reason: The lexical range supports day, appointed time, and decisive occasion; the local complement {{ar:ٱلتَّلَاقِ}} ({{tr:t-talāq}}) selects event-horizon.

topics.headline: variant and next verse foreground the Day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Day can move from temporal horizon to grammatical focus, and 40:16 immediately unfolds that scene.
topics.reason: The local parse is accusative {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}), while nominative evidence foregrounds the Day as contrast; 40:16 then opens the exposure scene named by this closing phrase.

words.gloss_range: the definite Meeting as reciprocal convergence and the Day's defining content
words.root_gloss_range: the definite Meeting as reciprocal convergence and the Day's defining content

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلتَّلَاقِ}} ({{tr:t-talāq}}) is definite and genitive after {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}), so Meeting defines the Day rather than merely occurring on it. Its Form VI verbal-noun force makes the endpoint reciprocal convergence and accountable encounter. Because it shares the root-thread with {{ar:يُلْقِى}} ({{tr:yulqī}}), the ayah's present casting becomes preparation for the future Meeting; echoes such as 6:31 and the immediate 40:16 exposure scene keep the warning from sounding abstract. Variant final forms can retain a final long ī or hold stop-and-continuation together, lengthening the terminal horizon while the local grammatical role remains the closing genitive title.

topics.headline: Meeting defines the Day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word as the Day's defining title, not a separate object of warning.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make {{ar:ٱلتَّلَاقِ}} ({{tr:t-talāq}}) a definite genitive verbal noun complement of {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}).

topics.headline: Meeting is reciprocal encounter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the warned future as unavoidable convergence and confrontation, not an abstract doctrine.
topics.reason: The root and Form VI verbal noun support meeting, receiving, confronting, and mutual convergence; the warning context makes that encounter accountable.

topics.headline: final Meeting answers present casting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what God casts now prepares for what all will meet later.
topics.reason: The same root appears in {{ar:يُلْقِى}} ({{tr:yulqī}}) and {{ar:ٱلتَّلَاقِ}} ({{tr:t-talāq}}) with different forms, joining divine delivery to final reciprocal encounter.

topics.headline: Meeting echoes denial and exposure scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the warning before Meeting with denial of meeting God in 6:31 and the exposed-presence scene in 40:16.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references: 6:31 for denial of meeting God and 40:16 for the immediate exposure scene after {{ar:ٱلتَّلَاقِ}} ({{tr:t-talāq}}).

topics.headline: final cadence stretches closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final Meeting word as an extended terminal horizon, while the base role remains genitive complement.
topics.reason: The local grammar keeps {{ar:ٱلتَّلَاقِ}} ({{tr:t-talāq}}) as genitive complement; yā-retention and pause-continuation evidence affects recitational closure and cadence rather than changing the syntactic role.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ... يُلْقِى ٱلرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ ... مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Height, graded order, and throne establish sovereign control; that control becomes action when a command-bearing spirit is cast onto a chosen dependent, converting hierarchy into delegated warning.

activation_trace.role: High rank supplies the upper pole of the commission's vertical order.
Taking degree by degree makes the hierarchy an ordered channel rather than a single height.
The elevated royal seat identifies the source as governing authority.
Casting supplies the directional transfer from sovereign source onto the recipient.
Command makes the transferred spirit an authorization or charge, not an ownerless impulse.
Submissive service defines the recipient as dependent while enabling delegated action.
Fear-awakening warning is the commission's stated output.

changed_reading.before: A sequence of divine titles followed by the bestowal of revelation on a messenger.
changed_reading.after: The titles define a delivery architecture: elevated sovereignty sends an authorized, animating charge through a selected servant until it becomes warning.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root ل ق ي occurs in يُلْقِى and ٱلتَّلَاقِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: One root spans an asymmetrical present act and a reciprocal future event: what is cast now prepares the servant and hearers for the encounter later.

activation_trace.role: The present pole is a one-way casting or placing.
The future pole is two sides arriving face to face.
The day as a severe event gives the encounter an eventful rather than merely calendrical force.

changed_reading.before: Casting the spirit and the Day of Meeting are two unrelated clauses.
changed_reading.after: The repeated root forms a temporal hinge: a message is placed into history now so that the later face-to-face convergence is not met unwarned.

baseline_models.mechanism: Spirit can be life and moving air, while the same casting root includes imparting and receiving speech; the deposited life-current therefore becomes voiced warning through the servant.

activation_trace.role: Life-bearing spirit supplies animation rather than bare information.
Wind and breath supply a mobile medium that can pass from source through a speaker.
Imparting and receiving speech connects the spirit's arrival to communicable wording.
Making news public supplies the outward broadcast stage.
The broadcast is functionally aimed at waking caution.

changed_reading.before: Spirit is an unspecified heavenly item bestowed on a recipient.
changed_reading.after: Spirit is also readable as a vivifying, breath-like transmission that becomes receivable speech and then public warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first delivers a written book downward, then immediately before the focus sends sky-provision downward to one who turns back. Together with spirit as wind, life, and vegetative renewal, this revises the courtly dispatch into a provision-like descent that must be received and made fruitful.

activation_trace.role: Wind gives the spirit a mobile, descending medium.
Vegetative breaking-forth supplies the possible fruit of the descent in its recipient.
Sending down and delivering establishes textual revelation as the first downward gift.
Ordered letters keep the descent tied to articulated communication.
A second delivered descent places provision directly beside the focus ayah.
Rain descending as provision supplies an ecological analogy for spirit reaching and reviving a servant.
Repeated return supplies the receptive turn by which the descent becomes remembrance.

structural_cues: 40:2 opens the surah with a descent from God; 40:13 repeats descent from the sky immediately before 40:15.
40:13 links signs, provision, remembrance, and turning, so reception rather than mere arrival matters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two descents, rain-like provision, turning, and spirit's wind and growth images; I infer that provision models how spirit takes effect. A live alternative is that the parallel is only directional and the spirit remains wholly propositional revelation.

changed_reading.before: A royal command is transmitted from above.
changed_reading.after: The command also descends like apportioned rain: it reaches a receptive servant as communicative provision capable of animating, growing, and warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The three ayat after the focus unpack the meeting as forced emergence into an uncovered field, collapse of rival ownership, itemized recompense, and an event already drawing near.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face convergence supplies the event being unpacked.
A severe happening makes the meeting a decisive event.
Emergence and uncovering make every participant publicly present.
The negated hiding removes private shelter from the encounter.
Sole kingship determines who controls the exposed assembly.
Matching deed with consequence gives the meeting an adjudicative operation.
Counting and reckoning make each exposed history computable.
Nearness turns the account from remote doctrine into approaching pressure.

structural_cues: 40:16-18 directly follows the focus and repeats both day-language and the imperative to warn.
The sequence moves from public emergence, to recompense without injustice, to bodily constriction as the event approaches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, no hiding, sole kingship, recompense, reckoning, and nearness; I treat these as mechanics of ٱلتَّلَاقِ rather than adjacent themes. The meeting can still retain the broader sense of assembly.

changed_reading.before: The Day of Meeting is a general future gathering.
changed_reading.after: It is compelled face-to-face exposure in which hidden histories become countable, rival ownership ends, and deeds meet their corresponding consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: A believer inside Pharaoh's household moves from concealed faith to sustained public guidance. This activates the open wording 'whomever He wills among His servants' as warning agency that can surface from an unexpected social location, not only from an already visible office.

activation_trace.role: Will attached to a particular object keeps recipient selection open.
Service, rather than public rank, is the named recipient category.
Warning that wakes caution defines the selected servant's public function.
Heart-settling assent identifies the insider as a believer before his warning speech unfolds.
Concealment marks the socially unexpected location from which warning emerges.
Gentle indication toward the true road turns private belief into public guidance.
Straight direction against error specifies the content of the insider's guidance.

structural_cues: 40:28 names a believing man from Pharaoh's family who had concealed his faith, then gives him direct speech.
Across 40:28-38 he repeatedly addresses 'my people,' fears days of judgment for them, and invites them to follow a right path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies belief, concealment, emergence into speech, and guidance; I infer that this character instantiates the social openness of 'whomever He wills among His servants.' It does not establish that he directly received ٱلرُّوحَ or held prophetic office; he may instead be a downstream responder.

changed_reading.before: The chosen servant is assumed to be only the already identified formal messenger.
changed_reading.after: The wording also leaves room for warning to be activated in a concealed believer inside a hostile institution, distributing commissioned speech beyond obvious public rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh constructs a high building and seeks connections by which to climb, inspect, and seize certainty about the God of Moses. Against this attempted upward capture, the focus defines true height operationally: the throne-holder is known by freely casting command downward, not by being reached through engineered elevation.

activation_trace.role: High rank anchors the contrast in the focus ayah's own elevation language.
Royal sovereignty distinguishes genuine rule from Pharaoh's architectural performance.
Casting downward makes height productive through outgoing agency.
The high constructed building supplies counterfeit, mechanically acquired elevation.
Reaching a goal supplies Pharaoh's attempted upward endpoint.
A rope or connective means materializes the imagined route to the heavens.
The repeated connective means extends the attempted route into the next ayah.
What is above and overshadows supplies the domain Pharaoh tries to penetrate.
An elevated approach supplies the attempted climb and inspection.

structural_cues: 40:36-37 pairs a ruler's command to build upward with his desire to reach heavenly means and inspect Moses' God.
The attempt ends in decorated bad action, obstruction from the path, and ruin rather than access.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the tower, attempted reach, heavenly connections, and ascent; I supply the directional contrast that genuine authority sends while counterfeit authority tries to seize by climbing. The episode may also function more narrowly as exposure of Pharaoh's skepticism.

changed_reading.before: God's high degrees and throne primarily locate Him at the top of a cosmic hierarchy.
changed_reading.after: Height chiefly names unseizable agency: the true sovereign reaches servants by sending command downward, while built ascent cannot capture or authenticate Him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late creation sequence moves a human through measured, irreversible states from material origin to gestation, childhood, maturity, old age, death, and a named term. It activates 'degrees' as temporal development under the life-giver, so the spirit-warning enters a finite life-course before its terminal meeting.

activation_trace.role: Taking degree after degree supplies the focus anchor for staged development.
Life-bearing spirit places the commission within an animate life-course.
Bringing creation into being initiates the staged sequence.
A minute fluid origin supplies an early material degree.
A pregnancy fixed in the womb supplies the next dependent degree.
The small newborn marks emergence into a visible human stage.
Reaching a limit links maturity and the final appointed endpoint.
Taking the life closes some courses before every listed stage is traversed.
A fixed temporal limit gives the developmental ladder a terminal boundary.
Animate life confirms that the stages remain governed by the life-giver.

structural_cues: 40:67 uses repeated ثُمَّ to order dust, drop, clinging stage, child, maturity, old age, death, and appointed term.
40:68 immediately compresses that sequence into giving life, causing death, and effective command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit temporal sequence and the focus branch supplies stepwise degrees; I map the sequence back onto ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ as life stages. Static ranks remain a live and stronger lexical alternative.

changed_reading.before: The degrees are fixed heights or ranks possessed by the throne-holder.
changed_reading.after: They also name the staged trajectories He raises creatures through; spirit-warning arrives during a bounded human course to orient it toward the final encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sends spirit from God's command or affair to a servant. Later the servant entrusts his own affair back to God and is protected; divine command then appears as effective speech, while messenger action remains bounded by permission. Commission is therefore a two-way but asymmetric circuit of entrustment, authorization, action, and return.

activation_trace.role: Affair or state permits the relational reading that will be mirrored by the servant's affair.
Binding command preserves the unequal authority within the exchange.
Returning an affair to another in reliance reverses the focus ayah's initial direction.
The servant's own affair forms the lexical mirror of the divine affair or command.
Divine seeing makes entrusted service supervised rather than abandoned.
The repeated servant category ties the returning affair to the focus recipient.
Protection supplies the contextual result of entrusting the affair.
Effective completion makes divine command perform rather than merely advise.
Occurrence in time supplies the realized endpoint of the spoken command.
Permission sets a boundary around what a messenger may produce.
The arriving divine command retains final initiative.
Decisive judgment marks the command's terminal exercise of authority.

structural_cues: 40:44-45 moves from the believer's entrusting his affair to divine sight and protection.
40:68 presents command as speech that immediately occurs; 40:78 denies autonomous signs to messengers and reserves the arriving command and judgment to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored occurrences of 'affair,' effective command, permission, and protection; I infer a governed exchange rather than one-way possession. The materially live alternative is polysemy: 'His command' and 'my affair' may remain distinct senses with no reciprocal circuit.

changed_reading.before: Spirit descends as a one-way grant of power to an autonomous charismatic agent.
changed_reading.after: The servant receives a licensed charge, returns his own affair in reliance, acts under divine sight, and never controls the command's efficacy or timing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spirit-borne warning is an effective call placed before the meeting. The surah later names a Day of mutual calling, shows calls in punishment failing, and ends with belief no longer benefiting after force is seen. Warning therefore opens a response window that the encounter closes.

activation_trace.role: Publicizing news supplies the warning's pre-encounter broadcast.
Moving air supplies a contained image for the warning's carried voice.
Awakening caution defines the useful call while response remains possible.
The eventual encounter supplies the closing boundary.
Raised voice activates the Day of Calling as an acoustic counterpart to warning.
The second mapped call branch preserves the day as a field of elevated voices.
Calling by speech now fails to incline events or produce rescue.
Negated benefit states that late belief has lost practical efficacy.
An established recurring path makes closure of the window a stable rule.
Elapsed generations extend that rule through prior time.

structural_cues: 40:32 calls the feared event the Day of Calling; 40:49-50 stages pleas and calls after entry into punishment.
40:84-85 places professed belief after sight of force and explicitly denies it benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, later mutual calls, failed calls, and useless late belief; I infer that the warning's purpose is to preserve a usable interval before encounter. A narrower alternative treats these as separate scenes joined only by judgment.

changed_reading.before: To warn of the Day means to announce frightening future content.
changed_reading.after: The warning is a timed, answerable call: spirit opens communication before the Day becomes a cacophony of ineffective calls and direct encounter ends response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 40:15 never says the servant 'carries' the spirit. It remains anchored in the spirit being cast upon a servant and in the surah's repeated literal carriers of throne and humans; downstream prose should present it only as a material relay analogy, not as a lexical gloss or claim about mechanism.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُلْقِى ٱلرُّوحَ ... عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ

activation_trace.role: Casting onto another supplies the first transfer in the proposed relay.
Life-bearing spirit is the nonmaterial load transferred to the servant.
The serving recipient becomes the possible middle carrier rather than the source.
Warning is the load's outward delivery to further recipients.
Bearing a visible load supplies the first literal carrier structure.
The royal throne itself appears within a carried support relation.
A vessel moving through water supplies another designed carrier.
Humans being borne completes the surah's repeated load-transfer analogy.

changed_reading.before: The servant is only the terminal recipient of spirit.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the servant is a relay-bearing surface: as throne and humans are carried by supports, spirit is placed on a servant so warning can be carried onward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because رَفِيعُ normally signals elevation, not release from chains. The focus inventory nevertheless includes lifting a prisoner's fetter, and 40:71 supplies literal collars, linked chains, and dragging; downstream prose should retain it only as a qualified counterimage of enabled warning versus final coercion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَفِيعُ ... يُلْقِى ٱلرُّوحَ ... عَلَىٰ ... عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ

activation_trace.role: A cord that lifts a prisoner's fetter supplies the odd but explicit release image.
A collar binding a limb supplies the final scene's bodily constraint.
Connected links make the constraint continuous rather than momentary.
Dragging and extension oppose the chosen servant's enabled movement into warning.

changed_reading.before: رَفِيعُ contributes only height and rank.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory edge, divine elevation carries a faint counterimage of lifting constraint so a servant can transmit warning before refusal hardens into chained, externally compelled movement.

strongest_changes: The ل ق ي repetition became a temporal mechanism: present casting prepares future face-to-face exposure and account.
The static درجات hierarchy reopened as the measured life stages through which a finite servant moves before the meeting.
Divine height became outgoing, unseizable agency when contrasted with Pharaoh's failed engineered ascent.
Warning became an answerable pre-encounter communication window, while the chosen servant category expanded toward an unexpected concealed insider.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly reversed the focus ayah's vectors: book and provision descend, Pharaoh tries to ascend, a servant returns his affair in trust, carriers relay loads, and late voices fail. Those reversals made the compact focus ayah read as a governed transmission system rather than a list of titles.
remaining_uncertainties: The provision and growth model for ٱلرُّوحَ may be only an ecological analogy; textual revelation remains the cleaner reading.
The concealed believer exemplifies open servant-selection socially, but the packet does not say that he directly received the spirit.
The reciprocal affair model depends on holding command and affair senses of ء م ر together; they may remain distinct.
Carrier and lifted-fetter readings are deliberately contained material analogies, not proposed lexical translations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The spirit is cast downward as an animating charge.** `ر ف ع/B001` supplies upward elevation, while `ل ق ي/B005` supplies casting something before or upon another and `ر و ح/B001` the life-spirit. The vertical reversal is explicit. I infer that the cast spirit animates warning in the recipient; revelation reads as transferred vitality from height into speech.
2. **The warned day is a forced face-to-face convergence.** The second occurrence, in التلاق, activates `ل ق ي/B004`, two things coming face to face. Its echo with the prior casting connects message and meeting. I infer that the cast warning prepares recipients for unavoidable encounter; “meeting” includes confrontation among agents, deeds, and judgment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The total exposure of 40:16 and witnessed standing of 40:51 sharpen “meeting” into public confrontation, while 40:70 preserves the cast message’s eventual knowledge-effect.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A vertical dispatch prepares a face-to-face encounter.** Lexically, `ل ق ي:B005` is "casting something where it is met" in `يلقي`, while `B004` is "two things coming face to face" in `التلاق`; `ر ف ع:B002` supplies high rank. Structurally, high degrees and throne stand above a spirit cast onto a servant, whose function is to warn of the meeting day; 40:16 then makes everyone exposed. The two L-Q-Y forms act as dispatch and destination. The packet supplies the downward casting and later universal encounter; I infer that the dispatch prepares recipients to face its source. The ayah reads as one spatial communication circuit, from height through a chosen bearer to unavoidable meeting.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 40:51-52 turns the meeting into an explicitly juridical assembly where witnesses stand and excuses lose effect, sharpening the face-to-face destination of the cast warning.

error_profile.preserves: Daha yüksek bir konuma geçme yönünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal konumu yukarı doğru değiştirirken komşu dal nesneyi elden yere veya daha aşağı, kararlaştırılmış bir konuma bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir nesneyi yerinden yukarı taşıma eylemini ve yapı yükseltmeyi belirginleştirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bulutun yükselmesi gibi daha geniş kendiliğinden yükselme ve yücelme durumlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisinin çekirdeğinde daha yüksek bir konuma geçiş veya geçirme bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal özellikle fiziksel bir nesnenin yukarı alınmasına dayanır; komşu dal ise ettirgenlik aramadan genel yükselme ve yücelmeyi daha geniş biçimde kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Daha yüksek konuma götüren hareketi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin üstte veya yukarı yönde bulunma ilişkisini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da düşey yükseklik ve üst-alt eksenini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir konum değişikliği eylemidir; komşu dal ise hareket gerektirmeyen bir yer ve yön ilişkisini belirtir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; düşey hareketin karşıtı, genel yükselme ve üstte bulunma ile sınırı en açık gösteren üç komşu seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişinin onurlu ve yüksek konumlu oluşunu, aşağılanmanın karşıtı olan saygınlığı ve bir anılışın ya da konumun yüceltilmesini aynı değer ekseninde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal toplumsal veya simgesel değerin yükselmesini kapsar; fiziksel taşıma ve yalnızca ün kazanma bu çekirdeğin yerini tutmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimler yüksek saygınlık durumunu anlatır; anılışı, konumu, belgeleri veya yapıları yüceltmeye bağlı kalıplar ayrı bağlamsal gerçekleşmelerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin, anılışın veya konumun değer ve saygınlık bakımından yüksek olması ya da bu yüksek konuma çıkarılmasıdır. Aşağılanmanın karşıtıdır ve fiziksel yükseklik bildirmez.

facets.statement: Kişinin yüksek saygınlığa ve onurlu bir konuma sahip olması.
Bir kişinin, anılışın veya konumun saygınlığını artırıp onu yüceltmek.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar yüksek saygınlık ile aşağılanma arasındaki karşıtlığı temel alır; kişinin onurlu oluşunu ve anılış ya da konumun yüceltilmesini bu temel çevresinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem onurlu ve yüksek konumlu olma durumunu hem de birine ya da bir şeye bu değeri kazandırmayı kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Yüksek saygınlık durumunu ve bu duruma çıkarma işlemini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin sahip olduğu saygın konumu niteleyen durum kullanımı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin saygınlığını ve yüksek toplumsal değerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin, anılışın, belgenin veya yerin saygınlığının artırıldığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Değeri ve saygınlığı etkin biçimde artırma yönünü korur.
Bir kişinin başkalarınca tanınması ihtimalini korur.
error_profile.loses: Onur, yüksek değer ve aşağılanmaya karşıt saygınlık çekirdeğini kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Saygınlık gerektirmeyen sıradan tanınmışlık anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Kötü bir nedenle tanınmış kişi de ünlü olabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Saygınlığı artıran eylemi ve anılış ya da konum gibi nesnelerin yüceltilmesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yüksek toplumsal tabakayı ve seçkin kişileri adlandıran daha geniş kullanımları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın merkezinde yüksek değer, onur ve saygınlık bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hem yüksek saygınlık durumunu hem de onu artırma eylemini işler; komşu dal yüksek onur alanını ve seçkinlik adlarını daha geniş biçimde kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişinin veya konumun değerini ve saygınlığını yükseltir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişiyi küçümseyip değerini düşürür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişiye verilen toplumsal değerin yönünü belirler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal değer ve onur kazandırırken komşu dal bunları azaltan küçümseme yönünde işler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Saygınlığın kendisini ve onu yükseltme eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsanlar arasında yayılan iyi ünü ve olumlu tanınmışlığı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal olumlu toplumsal değerlendirme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kişinin değer ve onur düzeyine ilişkindir; komşu dal ise bu değerin toplumda yayılmış iyi bir ün olarak görünmesine odaklanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; onur alanındaki en yakın komşu, karşıt değer yönü ve iyi ünle karışma riski sınırı açıklayan üç ilişki olarak seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bineğin ağır yürüyüşten daha hızlı fakat tam koşudan daha düşük bir gidişini ve hayvanın yürüyüşünü belirgin biçimde hızlandırmayı birlikte gösterir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel hız kavramı değil, binek hayvanının belirli yoğunluk ve aralıkta gerçekleşen yürüyüş biçimidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Biçim birimleri belirli bir yürüyüş türünü adlandırır; kalıba bağlı kullanım ise bineğin yürüyüşünü bu düzeye çıkarma eylemini ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir binek hayvanının ağır yürüyüşten hızlı, tam koşudan daha düşük bir hızla güçlü biçimde ilerlemesidir. Aynı alan, hayvanın yürüyüşünü bu yoğunluğa çıkarma eylemini de kapsar.

facets.statement: Binek hayvanının ağır yürüyüş ile tam koşu arasında güçlü ve hızlı ilerlemesi.
Bineğin yürüyüşünü olağandan daha güçlü ve hızlı hale getirmek.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar bu yürüyüşü ağır gidişin üstünde, tam koşunun altında konumlandırır; bazı ifadeler hız aralığını, bazıları ise yürüyüşü artırma eylemini öne çıkarır.

concept_gloss.text: bineğin orta-üst hızda ilerlemesi veya ilerletilmesi
concept_gloss.applicability: Binek hayvanının ağır yürüyüş ile tam koşu arasındaki güçlü gidişini ve bu gidişe yöneltilmesini birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Binek bağlamını, ara hız düzeyini, ilerleyişi ve ettirgen kullanımı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın gidiş biçiminin anlatıldığı, tam koşuya varmayan hızlı yürüyüş bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İlerleyişin güçlü ve hızlı niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Hızın ağır yürüyüş ile tam koşu arasındaki özel yerini açıkça belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ağır yürüyüşle tam koşu arasında hızlı gidiş

error_profile.preserves: Hızlı ilerleme yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Tam koşuyu ve binek dışındaki her türlü koşuyu sınırsız biçimde kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Kaynakta belirtilen ara yürüyüş düzeyini en üst hızla karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Binek hayvanının çeşitli hızlı yürüyüşlerini ve onu genel olarak hızlandırmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: ara hızlı yürüyüş ve hızlı binek gidişi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da binek hayvanının hızlı ilerlemesi ve sürücünün onu hızlandırmasıyla ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hızın alt ve üst sınırını belirli bir aralıkta tutar; komşu dal ise belirli bir aralık şartı olmadan hızlı binek yürüyüşlerini kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Binek türleri arasında kullanılabilen ve tam koşunun altında kalan bir hız düzeyidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle develerin ardışık ve atılgan ilerleyişini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da devenin olağandan hızlı ve güçlü yürüyüşünü anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hız derecesini ağır yürüyüş ile tam koşu arasında tanımlar; komşu dal develerin peş peşe atılgan ilerleyiş biçimine odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yürüyüşü hız aralığıyla tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Boyunların alçaltılması gibi belirli bir beden duruşunu ve ciddi gidişi şart koşar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: hız derecesi ve boyun alçaltarak gidiş
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da binek hayvanlarının güçlü ve hızlı ilerleyişini betimler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı yönü hız derecesidir; komşu dalın ayırıcı yönü ise hızlı gidişe eşlik eden alçak boyun duruşudur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi genel yaklaştırma çekirdeğini açıkça verir ve kişi ya da anlatılan bir işi yönetici veya yargı yetkisi olan kimsenin önüne getirmeyi bunun kurumsal özel kullanımı olarak gösterir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bir şeyi yaklaştırma veya yetkili önüne sunma eylemidir; haberin kamuya yayılması ayrı bir anlamdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim yaklaştırmayı anlatır; kişiyi, davayı veya anlatılan işi bir yetkilinin önüne sunan kalıplar bu çekirdeğin kurumsal özel kullanımlarıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi daha yakına getirmek veya öne almaktır. Yönetim ve yargı bağlamında kişi, dava ya da anlatılan iş yetkili önüne çıkarılarak değerlendirmeye sunulur.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bulunduğu yere göre yakına getirmek veya öne almak.
Bir kişiyi, davayı veya anlatılan işi karar verecek yetkilinin önüne sunmak.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar genel yaklaştırma ile yönetici ya da yargıç önüne sunmayı aynı öne getirme yönünde birleştirir; kurumsal örnek çekirdeği bütünüyle daraltmaz.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem genel öne getirme eylemini hem de kişi ya da işin karar verecek makama sunulmasını kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Yaklaştırma çekirdeğini ve yetkili önüne çıkarma özel kullanımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi veya işin yönetici ya da yargıç tarafından görülmek üzere sunulduğu bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yetkiliye doğru yaklaştırma ve değerlendirmeye sunma işlemini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: onu iki perdenin bulunduğu yere kadar ilerletmek

error_profile.preserves: Bir işin yetkiliye ulaşması sonucunu kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişiyi veya işi yaklaştırıp yetkili önüne çıkarma işlemini kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Yalnızca sözlü ya da yazılı bilgi verme anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Haber yayma dalıyla kolayca karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Haberi belirli bir karar makamıyla sınırlamadan açığa çıkarıp yayar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir içeriğin başka kişilere ulaştırılması görülebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın hedefi karar verecek belirli bir yetkilidir ve sunma işlemi öne çıkar; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise haberin görünür ve yaygın hale gelmesidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yetkili önüne kişi, dava veya anlatılan iş sunma kullanımını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yakınlık, akrabalık ve iki şey arasında yakınlaşma gibi daha geniş ilişkileri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir şeyi daha yakın konuma getirme anlamında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel yaklaştırmaya ek olarak kurumsal sunmayı içerir; komşu dal ise fiziksel ve ilişkisel yakınlığın daha geniş alanına yayılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişiyi veya işi bizzat yetkilinin önüne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir sonuca ulaşmak için kanıt, hak, mal veya aracı ileri sürer.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yetkili önüne sunmak ve araç ileri sürmek
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir hüküm veya istenen sonuç karşısında bir şeyi öne getirmeyi içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sunulan kişi ya da işin yetkiliye yaklaştırılmasına dayanır; komşu dal ise sonuca götüren bir aracın veya dayanağın kullanılmasına dayanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi, özellikle gizli kalmış bir haberi açığa çıkarıp yaymayı ve bunu aktaran bir topluluğu açıkça aynı duyurma alanında toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal haberin görünür ve yaygın hale gelmesini gerektirir; yalnızca bir yetkiliye sunmak veya haber istemek yeterli değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim açığa çıkarıp yaymayı anlatır; belirli kişi ve yönetici ilişkisine bağlı kalıp ile haber taşıyan topluluk adı ayrı gerçekleşmeler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir haberi gizli veya sınırlı kaldığı durumdan çıkararak başkalarının bilgisine açmak ve yaymaktır. Haberi taşıyıp duyuran topluluk bu eyleme bağlı bir kullanım oluşturur.

facets.statement: Bir haberi açığa çıkarıp insanlar arasında yaymak.
Aktardığı haberi başkalarına ulaştırıp yayan topluluk.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar haberin gizlilikten çıkarılıp yayılmasında birleşir; haberi duyuran topluluk, temel yayma eyleminin katılımcısı olarak ayrıca belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir haberin gizli veya dar çevrede kalmaktan çıkıp başkalarına duyurulduğu bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Açığa çıkarma, duyurma ve yayılma aşamalarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Haberin bir topluluk aracılığıyla birçok kişiye ulaştırıldığı akıcı metin bağlamlarında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Haberi başkalarına ulaştırma ve yayma işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Daha önce gizli olan içeriği açığa çıkarma ayrıntısını açıkça söylemez.

error_profile.preserves: Bir içeriği başkasının bilgisine ulaştırmayı korur.
error_profile.adds: Tek kişiye özel ve yayılmayan her türlü bilgilendirmeyi de kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Açığa çıkarma ve yayma koşulları görünmez hale gelir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir haberi etkin biçimde açığa çıkarıp yaymayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sözün veya haberin taşarcasına kendiliğinden yayılmasını ve konuşmaya dalmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da haberin başlangıçtaki dar çevresinin dışına çıkması bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal duyuran kişinin veya topluluğun etkin yayma eylemine dayanır; komşu dal ise haberin yaygınlaşma durumunu ve konuşmanın genişlemesini de kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Haberin açığa çıkarılıp yayılma sürecini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Haberin kendisini ve onu bildirme ya da öğrenme ilişkilerini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal haberin kişiler arasında bilgi olarak aktarılması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal içeriğin yaygın hale getirilmesine odaklanır; komşu dal ise haber türündeki içeriği ve bildirme ilişkisini, yayılma şartı olmadan kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Haberi geniş bir çevrenin bilgisine açar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişi veya işi karar verecek belirli bir yetkili önüne getirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir içerik ilk sahibinden başka bir alıcıya ulaştırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda amaç haberin görünür ve yaygın olmasıdır; komşu dalda amaç belirli kişi veya işin yetkili tarafından değerlendirilmesidir.
